definition_zh: 威吓；欺凌；吓唬（迫使屈服）
definition_en: to intimidate someone into doing something by stern or bullying looks and words
core_image: 压低的眉毛像乌云，逼人低头
scene: 会议室里，上司瞪着眼一遍遍逼人签字。The manager browbeat the clerk into signing the unequal contract.
sceneCN: 这里 browbeat 是「威吓、欺凌」（第 1 个义项：以凶狠的言辞神色逼人屈服）；句意是经理威逼职员签下不平等合同。

derivatives.zh: 由过去分词转形容词，义为「被威吓的，逆来顺受的」
由现在分词转名词，义为「威吓，欺压」

senses.title: To intimidate into submission
senses.definition: to use stern looks and harsh words to force someone to give in
senses.definitionCN: 以严厉的神色和粗暴的言辞迫使某人让步
senses.example: The lawyer browbeat the witness into changing her answer.
senses.exampleCN: 律师威吓证人，逼她改口。
senses.why: The brow is the face of anger; beating down with the brow pictures a scowl that crushes resistance.
senses.whyCN: 眉毛（brow）是怒容所在，用「眉毛压打」描摹一副凶相把对方的反抗压垮。

senses.title: To bully habitually
senses.definition: to treat someone in a domineering, bullying way as a habit
senses.definitionCN: 习惯性地以颐指气使的方式欺压他人
senses.example: He browbeat his younger colleagues for years.
senses.exampleCN: 他多年来一直盛气凌人地欺负年轻同事。
senses.why: A repeated act of intimidation hardens into a manner of dealing with people.
senses.whyCN: 一次次的威吓累积成一种惯常待人方式，义项由动作转为作风。

senses.title: To hector in debate
senses.definition: to shout down or overbear an opponent in argument rather than reason with them
senses.definitionCN: 在争论中用声势压倒对方，而非以理服人
senses.example: The senator browbeat his rival instead of answering the question.
senses.exampleCN: 参议员不回答问题，只顾气势汹汹地压对手。
senses.why: When force of expression replaces force of argument, intimidation becomes a rhetorical weapon.
senses.whyCN: 当表达上的强势取代论据的力量，威吓便成了论辩武器，义项延伸到言辞交锋。

intro.en: Browbeat is an English compound: brow plus beat, first recorded in the late sixteenth century.
intro.cn: browbeat 是英语复合词：brow 加 beat，十六世纪末见于记载。

items.en: a reconstructed root bhru gave the word for the brow or eyebrow.
items.cn: 重构词根 bhru 演变出表示眉、额的词。

items.en: brū appeared for the brow, while bēatan meant to strike.
items.cn: 古英语 brū 指眉毛，bēatan 意为击打。

items.en: browbeat arose as a figure: to beat down with a scowling brow.
items.cn: browbeat 作为比喻产生：以怒眉压人、以凶相逼人。

items.en: the past participle browbeaten settled as the common form, meaning cowed.
items.cn: 过去分词 browbeaten 定型，表「被吓住的」。

items.en: browbeat now names any bullying by looks, tone or pressure.
items.cn: 如今 browbeat 泛指以神色、语气或压力欺凌逼人。

note.en: Browbeat keeps company with body-part verbs of intimidation and with near synonyms of bullying.
note.cn: browbeat 与身体部位构成的威慑类动词以及欺凌近义词相伴。

entries.definition: the strip of hair above the eye
entries.definitionCN: 眉毛，与 browbeat 同含 brow 一词

entries.definition: to mix or whip too much
entries.definitionCN: 搅拌过度，只是形近，与威吓义无关

entries.definition: to frighten someone into doing something
entries.definitionCN: 恐吓，威吓，与 browbeat 义近

entries.definition: to treat someone cruelly and repeatedly
to bully in an arrogant way

normalIntro.en: Picture a scowling brow doing the beating instead of a fist.
normalIntro.cn: 想象一双怒眉在动手打人，而非拳头。

normal.en: brow means the forehead; beat here means to strike down.
normal.cn: brow 指眉额，beat 在此指压打。

normal.en: The image is a scowl strong enough to knock you down.
normal.cn: 意象是一道凶得能把人打倒的怒容。

normal.en: The common participle is browbeaten, like beaten but with brows.
normal.cn: 常见分词是 browbeaten，像 beaten 但换成了眉毛。

normal.en: Browbeat someone into something is the fixed pattern.
normal.cn: browbeat someone into something 是固定句式。

normal.en: Bully uses fists; browbeat uses only the face.
normal.cn: bully 动拳头，browbeat 只用脸色。

abstract.en: Feel a shadow lean over you until your shoulders shrink.
abstract.cn: 感受一道阴影俯压过来，肩头不由收缩。

abstract.en: See two dark eyebrows slide lower and lower.
abstract.cn: 看见两道黑眉越压越低。

abstract.en: Hear a voice grind down every reply you start.
abstract.cn: 听一个声音把你开口的每句回话碾碎。

examples.en: The witness said she had been browbeaten by the prosecutor.
examples.cn: 证人说她曾被检察官威吓。

examples.en: Sales teams should coach, not browbeat, their trainees.
examples.cn: 销售团队应辅导新人，而非威压。

examples.en: He refused to be browbeaten into signing the deal.
examples.cn: 他拒绝在威逼下签署协议。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不饶比特」——他瞪着眉毛「不饶」人，一点「比特」的温和都没有，纯靠凶相压人。

root: browbeat 由 brow（眉、额，上溯原始印欧语重构词根 bhru）加 beat（打，古英语 bēatan）复合而成，属英语本土比喻构词：以「怒眉压打」表示用凶狠神色逼人屈服，无拉丁词源。

sensesIntro.en: One scowl that crushes resistance widens into a habit of bullying and then into overbearing debate.
sensesIntro.cn: 一道压垮反抗的怒容，先固化为惯常欺压，再延伸到论辩中的以势压人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a scowling brow pressing down like a fist.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道怒眉像拳头般压下。

branches.cn: 被压得不敢说话的员工

intro.en: Browbeat is a verb compound: a body part acts as the weapon.
intro.cn: browbeat 是动词复合词：身体部位充当「凶器」。

latinIntro.en: The compound is Germanic, but brow has distant Latin cousins in words like supercilium.
latinIntro.cn: 复合结构属日耳曼语源，brow 的远亲可见于拉丁语 supercilium（眉，引申傲慢）。

items.example: wipe the sweat from his brow
